brief:
Israeli occupation forces are withholding the bodies of three Palestinians killed in an airstrike that struck the Harash al-Saada neighborhood of Jenin city, according to Maan Wire. Video footage documented the detention of the three bodies in the aftermath of the strike.

The circumstances of the airstrike, including its timing and the specific identities of those killed, remain unclear from available reports at this time.
title: Israeli forces detain bodies of three Palestinians killed in Jenin airstrike
